name: ToolFlexy MediaFix – Image Optimizer, WebP/AVIF & Media Cleaner
author: toolflexy

sections.description:
ToolFlexy MediaFix is a free media toolkit for WordPress. Image processing stays on your server and no account, license key, cloud API, tracking, or usage limit is required.

Optional ToolFlexy Connect

The plugin includes an optional, disabled-by-default connection. Nothing is sent unless an administrator explicitly selects “Share installation data” and connects the site. When enabled, ToolFlexy receives the site URL, site title, WordPress/PHP versions, MediaFix version, locale, and connection status. The administrator email is sent only when the separate marketing checkbox is selected. Users can disconnect and request deletion from MediaFix > ToolFlexy Connect. Service: https://toolflexy.com/ Privacy: https://toolflexy.com/privacy-policy/

Image optimization

  • Optimize new uploads automatically or process existing images in a controlled queue.
  • Configure JPEG/PNG quality and maximum dimensions.
  • Create WebP and AVIF sidecars when the server image library supports them.
  • Deliver modern formats with a responsive picture element and original fallback.
  • Keep randomized-path original backups and restore optimized files.
  • See per-image savings and dashboard totals.

ALT text audit

  • Preview before changing metadata.
  • Use the related post, page, or product title; an SEO focus keyword; or a cleaned filename.
  • Recognizes Yoast SEO, Rank Math, SEOPress, and common AIOSEO keyword metadata.
  • Choose included or excluded categories, taxonomy terms, and Media Collections. Exclusions win.
  • Detect featured images, content images, page-builder data, product galleries, and custom fields.
  • Preserve existing ALT text, skip decorative images, and roll back recent changes.

Media library tools

  • Exact duplicate finder using file hashes.
  • Conservative unused-media review with references and site-branding protection.
  • Move reviewed attachments to WordPress Trash; never permanently delete them automatically.
  • Disable selected generated thumbnail sizes for future uploads.
  • Organize attachments with Media Collections.
  • Server capability and system-status checks.

Important: make a full backup and test on staging before bulk optimization or cleanup. A scanner cannot guarantee that dynamically referenced media is unused.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP from Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate ToolFlexy MediaFix.
  3. Open MediaFix > System Status and confirm that uploads are writable.
  4. Review Settings, then optimize one test image before starting a bulk operation.
sections.faq:
Does it use an external image service?

No. It uses the image libraries available through WordPress on your own server.

Will AVIF always be available?

No. AVIF and WebP creation depends on your hosting server’s GD or Imagick capabilities. MediaFix reports this in System Status.

Does the cleaner delete files automatically?

No. It only shows conservative candidates. A user with deletion permission must review and move an attachment to Trash.

Does it overwrite existing ALT text?

The default is missing-only mode. Existing ALT text is preserved. Preview and rollback are also available.
